purpose: A positional field `%3` after a resistor's value is refused, not dropped.

oracle.derivation: R card syntax (ngspice manual, Resistors): RXXX n+ n- value <mname> <l=length> <w=width> <temp=t> ...; the fourth field %3 names a model that does not exist. Xyce 7.10.0 exits 1 (netlist error at line 6); ngspice-44.2 and 45 exit 1 ("can't find model '%3'", "unknown parameter (%3)").

confirmed.result: ngspice exit 1: Error on line 6 or its substitute: / unknown parameter (%3); Xyce exit 1: Netlist error in file d.sp at or near line 6 / Netlist error in file d.sp at or near line 6
